Criterion 6 - `snapshot <dossier-vault>` reads a vault without Obsidian and writes the snapshot into bench/local/
Working directory: <tmp>/repo
Environment: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<tmp>/target
stdin: none
Only vaults generated under <tmp>/scratch were read; no real vault, nothing from ~/dev.

# 1. The vault generated by c7 from sbm-100
$ cargo run -q -p lophelia-bench -- snapshot <tmp>/scratch/vault-100
instantané : <tmp>/repo/bench/local/vault-100.json (100 nœuds, 347 arêtes, 4 communautés, modularité 0.586646)
--- exit code: 0 ---
$ grep -c node_modules bench/local/vault-100.json      -> 0
$ node ids of bench/local/vault-100.json vs bench/graphs/sbm-100.json -> identical
$ edge lines of bench/local/vault-100.json vs bench/graphs/sbm-100.json -> identical (347)

# 2. A hand-written vault
$ find hand -type f | sort
hand/A.md            "# A" / "[[B]] [[b|alias]] ![[B#titre]] [[dir/C.md]] [[absente]] [[P]] [[X]]"
hand/B.md            "# B"
hand/.cache/n.md     "# hidden" / "[[A]]"
hand/dir/C.md        "# C"
hand/d/X.md          "# X sub" / "[[C]]"
hand/note.txt        "not md [[A]]"
hand/.obsidian/app.json  {"userIgnoreFilters":["priv/","/x/"]}
hand/priv/P.md       "# P" / "[[A]]"
hand/X.md            "# X root"

$ cargo run -q -p lophelia-bench -- snapshot <tmp>/scratch/hand
avertissement : filtre regex non appliqué : /x/
instantané : <tmp>/repo/bench/local/hand.json (5 nœuds, 4 arêtes, 2 communautés, modularité 0.218750)
--- exit code: 0 ---

$ cat bench/local/hand.json
{"version":1,"nodes":[
{"id":"A.md","community":0},
{"id":"B.md","community":0},
{"id":"X.md","community":0},
{"id":"d/X.md","community":1},
{"id":"dir/C.md","community":1}
],"edges":[
[0,1],
[0,2],
[0,4],
[3,4]
]}
Read: A-B (three link forms merged into one edge), A-X.md (root X, shortest path), A-dir/C.md, d/X-dir/C.
priv/P.md excluded by app.json, .cache/ skipped, note.txt ignored, [[absente]] and [[P]] create no edge.
